preconditions.description: Number of queries is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 300000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of vertices in each tree is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for n, edges in zip(ns, edge_lists) for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are within the range of vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip(ns, edge_lists))
preconditions.description: Each tree has exactly n-1 edges.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(size, int) and 1 <= size <= n for size, n in zip(output, ns))
postconditions.description: Each output size is an integer within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(size == max_good_subtree_size(tree) for size, tree in zip(output, trees))
postconditions.description: Each output size is the maximum size of a good subtree for the corresponding tree.
